 Order

This is the second bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.670/2023 registered at Police Station - Kundipura mia, District Chhindwara (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 376,
376(2)(N), 376(3), 450 & 506 of IPC and 5(i)/6 of POCSO Act and 3(2)(V), 3(1)(va), 3(1) and 3(1)(W)(ii) of ST/SC Act.
Applicant is in detention since 25.10.2023.

His first application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 16.02.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.52637/2023.
2.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 25.10.2023.
He has been falsely implicated.
It is submitted that FIR was lodged after lapse of 7 months.
It is further submitted that regarding the date of birth, no reliable document has been submitted by the prosecution.
No ossification test has been conducted.
There is contradiction in the statement of prosecutrix and her father.

It is also submitted that there is no signature on the statement of the Vishal Wankhede vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75248178/

sentences.text: prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. Charge sheet has been filed.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
3. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant and submitted that prosecutrix is minor and her date of birth is 10.07.2008.
Birth certificate and marksheet have been produced in the Court.
It is also submitted that the prosecutrix has stated in her statement that the applicant- Vishal has committed rape with her.
Other witnesses have also deposed against the applicant.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
5.
Looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case as well as seriousness of offence, I am not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
Hence, the application is dismissed.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE anu Vishal Wankhede vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75248178/
